title.en: Fable 4 — The Lion and the Mouse

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: עכבר קטן הלך על אריה ישן.
sentences.en: A small mouse walked on a sleeping lion.
The lion woke up and caught him.

sentences.ar: העכבר ביקש: תעזוב אותי ואני אעזור לך.
sentences.en: The mouse asked: let me go and I will help you.
The lion laughed and let him go.
A month later the lion fell into a net.
The mouse came and gnawed through the ropes.
Even the small can help the great.
